# Prompt 23 browser capture

- `four-month-resolution-ledger.png`: Chromium at 1440 × 900 after the fixed four-month happy path. Full-page height is content-driven. It shows campaign Turn 5, the disabled completed-slice End Month control, and 20 ordered known-outcome rows (five source-defined groups for each of Months 1–4).

The capture is TEST_ONLY evidence, not production design certification. It contains no real observations, geography, hidden probability or hidden actor state.
